shield.name: Shield

operational.activation: Reaction — when the chosen creature is targeted by an attack roll or Magic Missile, before the attack or damage resolves
operational.targets: Self or one willing creature you can perceive within 30 feet
operational.duration: Until the start of your next regular turn
operational.resolution: None. Re-evaluate the triggering attack against the chosen creature's increased AC; negate Magic Missile damage to that creature while the spell lasts.
operational.effect: The chosen creature gains +5 AC until the start of your next regular turn. During the same duration, Magic Missile cannot deal damage to that creature.
operational.scaling: None. Damage dice, target count, range and duration do not automatically increase with character or class level.
operational.limitations: Does not protect against saving-throw effects, attacks that already resolved, or other automatically hitting effects unless explicitly named Magic Missile. Multiple Shield casts do not stack. Ranked casting causes normal Dissonance and Refrain.
operational.designNotes: Core V2 blocks and catalog summaries are preserved alongside this card. Components use the existing class focus where Core says F or M/F; this focus interpretation is provisional. Exact target eligibility, duration endpoints, saves where absent, concentration where unclear and anti-loop limits are provisional integration decisions.  GPT conference correction: retain Core30ft range; self-only narrowing rejected. One willing recipient is a provisional target specification.
operational.previousDraftDesignNotes: NEW provisional Reaction trigger and exact timing; numerical effects are preserved from both source placements.

operational.targets: One creature you perceive within30feet and line of effect. No requirement that its alignment be known; hidden canonical axes are resolved after paid casting.
operational.duration: Concentration, up to1minute. In initiative, expires at the caster's tenth future regular-start marker after application; an already-passed start never counts. Outside initiative, expires after 60 elapsed seconds. Retain the original virtual phase or absolute deadline through initiative changes, absence and planar travel; moving between timing modes does not reset it.
operational.resolution: The target makes a Wisdom save. Success: no new overlay. Failure: snapshot your actual current alignment orientation. For each axis defined both for you and for the target, compute one step toward your snapshotted value along Lawful–Neutral–Chaotic and Good–Neutral–Evil. Compute the target baseline without any previous Alignment Suggestion overlay on that target and, under the explicitly NEW DI7 AP-AS-01 exception, without any Alignment Purge overlay on that target. Under the NEW scoped AC4-ALIGN-01 exception, also exclude all Alignment Lock/Alignment Anchor overlays on this target when computing this baseline. Retain all other independent actual alignment effects/records. This target-only exclusion does not change the caster-orientation snapshot: an actual Purge on the caster still supplies Neutral/Neutral, subject to that caster's own active AC4 Lock/Anchor snapshot for the final effective read. An unsuppressed Purge on the target covers the resulting live Suggestion values until Purge ends or is suppressed; an eligible active Alignment Lock/Alignment Anchor snapshot applies last under AC4-ALIGN-01, without deleting, pausing or refreshing these lower records. An already matching or undefined axis gains no changed-value overlay. If at least one axis changes, replace the prior same-spell overlay with the new recorded axis values/deadline. A failed-save cast that changes no defined axis creates no new overlay and does not itself replace a valid older one; mandatory concentration transitions remain independent.
operational.effect: The changed values are the target’s actual effective canonical alignment for rules that query those axes during the overlay, including real alignment-gated spells/items. Example: baseline Chaotic Evil targeted by a Lawful Good caster becomes Neutral Neutral; one such overlay never jumps two steps. Its values remain fixed until expiry/removal/replacement and do not recompute every time another underlying record changes. Unchanged/unoverlaid axes follow their actual underlying records. An independent effect such as Corrupted can change underlying alignment while this spell persists; that change remains and is exposed when the applicable overlay ends. One Alignment Suggestion overlay per target across casters; recasting cannot use its old overlay as a staircase for another same-spell step. NEW scoped AC4-ALIGN-01: effective-alignment reads evaluate this live Suggestion overlay and the reviewed AP-AS-01 Purge interaction first, then apply the eligible active Alignment Lock/Alignment Anchor snapshot last. Lock/Anchor ending or inactivity exposes the then-live lower result with its original history/deadline; no ended overlay is restored. This adds no general alignment priority system.
operational.scaling: None. No automatic increase in range, targets, duration, magnitude or uses.
operational.limitations: The spell grants no automatic knowledge of either character’s axes, including whether a value changed. Actual information protections still govern observations. It never compels matching behavior, belief, confession, loyalty, PvP, personality or oathbreaking; conduct clauses still judge actual conduct. Ending removes only this overlay, without restoring an old alignment snapshot, deleting independent changes or reviving a replaced overlay. Caster orientation is fixed at application, not tracked through later caster changes. Ward tag creates no ward. More specific alignment-changing effects retain their actual interaction rules; this card does not invent a general priority engine for every unrelated overlay. Actual class access/repertoire, costs, components, Dissonance/Refrain, concentration transitions and cast/counter order follow SPELL_INTEGRATION_RULES.md. Pay a legal cast before effect resolution; failure/countering refunds nothing and restores no displaced concentration. V is audible, S requires the ordinary usable hand, and F is the normal class focus. Saves use the actual casting class's spell DC and binary save rules. Creature type alone supplies no mental immunity; Charmed-only immunity does not block effects that never impose Charmed. Actual broader defenses retain their written scope. No automatic scaling, generic upcast or free identification of hidden eligibility.
operational.designNotes: PRESERVED: Action/30feet/V,S,M/F as focus, WIS, concentration minute and actual push toward caster alignment. NEW: temporary canonical one-step overlay on both eligible axes. Exact-review proposals: compute without previous same-spell overlay to prevent recast ratcheting, overlay only genuinely changed axes, fixed values, and no new application when no defined axis changes; independent base changes survive ending.
operational.implementationStatus: REVIEWED authored operational PLAYTEST manuscript; runtime, human balance and broader Enchantment/social-control integration pending

burning-hands.name: Burning Hands

operational.targets: All creatures in a 15-foot cone originating from you
operational.resolution: Each target makes a Dexterity save against your spell save DC, taking 3d6 fire damage on failure or half on success.
operational.effect: Project a 15-foot cone of flame. All creatures in it make the stated save.
operational.scaling: None; damage remains 3d6 at all class levels.
operational.limitations: Targets behind total cover from the cone's origin are unaffected. The spell creates no persistent Burn, fire zone, or automatic ignition beyond ordinary environmental consequences of fire damage. Ranked casting causes normal Dissonance and Refrain.
operational.designNotes: Core V2 preserves Action, 15-foot range, Instantaneous duration, and V/S/F components, but gives only 'Automatic or opposed as described' and the source summary names no save. To avoid importing an unsupported save/half rule, this provisional record uses automatic damage to legal creatures in the cone. F is represented as an existing class casting focus. REVIEW CORRECTION: Core generic Automatic or opposed wording does not establish automatic damage. This pilot explicitly adds a Dexterity save for half; the initial no-save draft is retained in the audit only.
operational.previousDraftResolution: No attack roll or saving throw. Each legal target in the cone takes 3d6 fire damage.

protection-from-energy.name: Protection from Energy

operational.targets: One willing creature you can perceive within range and line of effect, including yourself.
operational.duration: If cast in initiative, expires at the caster's tenth future regular-start marker; preserve that virtual marker through order changes or departure. If cast outside initiative, expires 60 seconds after application; entering initiative preserves that absolute deadline. An already-passed start does not count.
operational.effect: Choose acid, cold, fire, lightning, thunder, force, necrotic or radiant. The target is immune to damage of that one type for the duration.
operational.limitations: Bludgeoning, piercing, slashing, poison, psychic and Corruption are not selectable energy types here. One Protection from Energy per target across all casters: a later application replaces the old type and owns its own deadline; stale cleanup cannot erase the replacement. Immunity blocks only the selected damage, not attached conditions or riders unless those independently require positive damage. It does not undo resolved damage or protect against a transferred post-defense branch expressly skipping a second mitigation/prevention stage. A magical weapon's physical damage remains physical. Apply SPELL_INTEGRATION_RULES.md for actual class access and repertoire, costs before resolution, components, concentration, Dissonance/Refrain and exact source cadence. No automatic scaling or generic upcast.
operational.designNotes: PRESERVED: immunity, Action, 30 feet, V/S/F and 1 minute without concentration. NEW: eight-type energy list, willing target, one all-caster application and explicit damage-only boundaries.
operational.implementationStatus: REVIEWED authored operational-playtest manuscript; runtime and balance validation pending

currentBookRow.exactText: Silence – Create a 20-foot-radius sphere of silence.

operationalCandidate.targets: Fixed center within 20 ft and line of effect; 20-ft-radius sphere.
operationalCandidate.resolution: Automatic acoustic field; no creature save.
operationalCandidate.effect: No sound originates, propagates or is heard within the sphere or crosses its boundary while active. A sound path between two outside listeners also fails when it must traverse the field. Speech-dependent V, audible commands, musical/hearing prerequisites and sound triggers fail according to their actual location/path. Visible signs and valid purely mental techniques remain possible.
operationalCandidate.limitations: This is an area acoustic rule, not a permanent Deafened/Silenced record on occupants, thunder immunity, vacuum, lost breathing or suppression of physical impact. A caster outside any blocking field can complete its V before its own new sphere appears and maintain concentration inside afterward; existing silence already covering that V prevents beginning the cast. Overlapping spheres have independent expiries.

protection-from-scrying.name: Protection from Scrying

operational.targets: One willing creature you can perceive within range and line of effect, including yourself.
operational.duration: 1 hour: expires 3,600 elapsed seconds after application; entering, leaving or reordering initiative does not change that deadline.
operational.resolution: Automatic after legal casting. Check an information-gathering effect's actual generating source classification, using its real casting-class school placement where applicable.
operational.effect: The target supplies no new information to effects explicitly classified as Divination or Scrying that attempt to perceive, locate, inspect, read, identify or otherwise obtain information about it. Apply this protection equally against hostile, neutral and beneficial information gathering. A multi-subject or area effect may still obtain permitted information about other subjects.
operational.limitations: No ordinary invisibility, concealment, false identity, attack defense, memory erasure, record deletion or retroactive protection. A class sense is blocked only insofar as its actual source classifies it as Divination/Scrying; the underlying class engine remains intact. Theme or guessed purpose is not classification. Known information remains known. Independent applications do not stack extra power and each retains its own endpoint. Apply SPELL_INTEGRATION_RULES.md for actual class access and repertoire, costs before resolution, components, concentration, Dissonance/Refrain and exact source cadence. No automatic scaling or generic upcast.
operational.designNotes: PRESERVED: Action, 60 feet, V/S/F and divination/scrying immunity. NEW CONFLICT RULING: ongoing 1 hour without concentration replaces Instantaneous metadata; immunity is operationally defined as prevention of new information about one willing target, not a blanket damage/benefit immunity against a school name.
operational.implementationStatus: REVIEWED authored operational-playtest manuscript; runtime and balance validation pending
